title: Stuttcars - Porsche 911 993 parts catalogs and diagrams
notes: Announces downloadable Porsche PET diagrams for the 993 but the files sit behind a paid membership; only promotional text was readable on 2026-08-28. The site declares no association with Porsche AG, so its right to redistribute PET material is unverified. Low priority while SRC-9XXTEILE-PET-DIAGRAMS is free.
